title: Countably many C¹ charts inside U covering a set carried by embedded C¹ submanifolds (Lindelöf; parent Step 2)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M N₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → (∀ l, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (N l)) → M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ l, N l → ∃ (V : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid P), (∀ s, IsOpen (V s) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ψ s) (V s) ∧ InjOn (ψ s) (V s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V s, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ s) y)) ∧ ψ s '' V s ⊆ U) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ s, ψ s '' V s
